title: Business Development Executive

description:
As BPX Group continues to grow, we are looking to strengthen our team and recruit a Business Development Executive to support the ambitious plans at our Newmarket branch (CB8 7 NY). We are looking for someone with strong sales experience who possesses the skills needed to identify new business opportunities and lead growth initiatives within the existing portfolio. The ability to build relationships, work in a team, and continually learn will make the difference in this role. About Us:

For 60 years BPX (part of the RS Group) has built a reputation as the leading independent distributor of factory automation and control components - from computers to connectors, from robots to relays and everything in between. We now employ over 180 people and from our 15 locations throughout the UK & Ireland, we provide a local service to our customers.

Adopt a consultative approach to sales, presenting solutions to customers that deliver value and help solve their industrial control and automation challenges

Balance the demands of prospecting for new business, in addition to enhancing relationships and contact points within the existing account portfolio.

Maintain a presence in the BPX branch, staying close to the people and local market.

Support marketing activities such as campaigns and promotions to increase customer awareness of product launches, events, competitions, etc.

Commit to learning, development, and training in both technical and non-technical areas.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience:

Experience in B2 B sales, ideally with knowledge of the industrial distribution market.

Drive sales growth opportunities through new and existing accounts/partnerships.

Familiar with the market dynamics between manufacturers, distributors, and customers.

Strong relationship builder, communicator, and team player.

Customer-centric, able to identify challenges and present solutions.

Organised and able to prioritise as required.

Committed to build knowledge across industrial control and automation products.

Familiar with CRM systems and able to produce sales reports.

title: Logistics Sales Executive
description:
Logistics Sales Executive Ipswich
Competitive salary
1 day WFH
Hours 9am 5.30 PM
Pension
Gym Discount
Social events
Private Medical

Helping businesses move forward. Quite literally!

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, has a natural interest in business and sales, and wants to play an important role in supporting a busy Commercial and Sales team.

The position will involve identifying and researching new business opportunities, qualifying incoming leads, supporting the sales process and ensuring that potential customers are followed up and developed effectively.

Working closely with internal and external Commercial teams, the successful candidate will help connect the dots between marketing, sales and operations, ensuring opportunities are captured, developed and progressed.

It's a varied role that combines commercial awareness, customer communication, research, organisation and administration. No two days should look exactly the same!

This isn't simply about sending quotes and hoping for the best. It's about understanding businesses, identifying their challenges and demonstrating how the right logistics partner can make their supply chains work smarter, more efficiently and cost-effectively.

The Role

The successful candidate will act as a trusted logistics consultant, taking the time to understand customers' businesses and identifying opportunities to add genuine value.

With a comprehensive range of multimodal logistics solutions, including road, air, sea freight and customs services, the business has the expertise and flexibility to manage a wide variety of logistics requirements.

Responsibilities will include:
- Identifying, developing and winning new business opportunities across the UK.
- Building strong, long-term relationships with new and existing customers.
- Growing customer accounts by identifying additional service opportunities.
- Understanding customer supply chains and recommending efficient, cost-effective logistics solutions.
- Working with UK and overseas offices to develop commercial opportunities.
- Preparing tailored proposals and presenting solutions to prospective customers.
- Managing and maintaining the CRM system (Zoho Bigin) and sales pipeline.
- Following up marketing-generated leads and developing new opportunities.
- Attending exhibitions, trade shows and networking events.
- Reviewing customer requirements and gathering relevant information to help develop suitable, cost-effective logistics solutions.
- Preparing commercial information, reports and proposals to support the wider team.
- Providing general commercial and administrative support to ensure the smooth running of the sales function.

Experience & Skills

The business is looking for someone with a positive attitude, strong organisational skills and a genuine interest in developing within a commercial environment.

Previous experience in logistics, freight forwarding, sales support, customer service or administration would be advantageous, but attitude, ability and willingness to learn are equally important.

Ideally, candidates will have:
- Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, import/export or commercial sales.
- An understanding of international trade, Incoterms and supply chain processes.
- Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
- Strong commercial awareness and the ability to identify new opportunities.

The Opportunity

Joining a hardworking, ambitious and growing business, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to take ownership of their customer portfolio, explore new markets and make a genuine contribution to the company's commercial growth.

This is a role for someone who wants to do more than sell freight. Someone who enjoys solving problems, building partnerships and helping businesses improve the way they move their goods.

If you're commercially switched on, enjoy a challenge and want to be part of an ambitious logistics business with exciting plans for the future, this could be the perfect next move.

After all, the world isn't going to move itself!
